source.title: Changes in the WCA Board of Directors (January 2025)
source.content:
Due to the vacancies in the Board of Directors, an anonymous election took place on January 1, 2025 to elect new members. The election was done according to [Motion 5.2024.1: Election of Directors.](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/05.2024.1%20-%20Election%20of%20Directors.pdf)

The Board received applications from:

* Dan Smith

We are happy to announce that the election was successful and that Dan was elected as the new member of the WCA Board of Directors! We wish him the best of luck with his duties!

The application can be viewed [here](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Lv9DCkcF7zch0056Ddrytdvm6t-ZPvlc/view?usp=sharing).

translation.title: WCA 董事会成员变动（2025 年 1 月）
translation.content:
由于董事会存在空缺，WCA 于 2025 年 1 月 1 日举行了无记名投票，选举新董事。选举依据[《议案 5.2024.1：董事选举》](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/05.2024.1%20-%20Election%20of%20Directors.pdf)进行。

董事会收到以下申请人的材料：

* Dan Smith

我们很高兴地宣布，选举顺利完成，Dan 当选 WCA 董事会新成员！祝他工作顺利！

申请材料可在[这里](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Lv9DCkcF7zch0056Ddrytdvm6t-ZPvlc/view?usp=sharing)查看。
